blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The wrapper implementations establish no direct holder freeze, while upstream yzUSD and reserve-asset access exposure remains inherited.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-09 on both deployments. At Plasma block 29369955 the syzUSD proxy 0xc8a8df9b210243c55d31c73090f06787ad0a1bf6 resolves EIP-1967 implementation 0xa3982582016375a0b25cb7d572379d3d49e5e9c8 and admin 0x7392751a860a51694231c7a0b4a9c853f8169cf0, asset() returns yzUSD 0x6695c0f8706c5ace3bdf8995073179cca47926dc, paused() is false, and freeze-family probes such as isBlacklisted(address) revert; that ProxyAdmin's owner() is Safe 0xa2a9700407934e913c840556b3d29f19cf6f203d with getThreshold() 4 and no timelock. At Monad block 94595184 the proxy 0x484be0540ad49f351eaa04eeb35df0f937d4e73f resolves implementation 0xe536b80e7f859e72ad095d769da1da45b7312d53 and admin 0x7040b88de8a8e63b9dffe2250f8062dcc1ca7331, whose owner() is TimelockController 0xd32ab76a165f1a716986ba8c58344e3df4397f5e with getMinDelay() 43200 seconds. The issuer's pinned source documents pause() as scoped to mint and redeem, adds no transfer hook, and blocks rescueTokens on the vault asset while supply is nonzero, so no live holder-selective freeze exists locally; the live proxy admins mean one could be added by upgrade. Backing is the single 100% reserve slice yzusd-yuzu, whose own verdict is possible over issuer-freezable reserve assets, so the named upstream exposure is retained and the verdict stays inherited rather than being collapsed into a token-local possible.

oracleRisk.summary: syzUSD is Yuzu's staking wrapper over yzUSD; its share price accrues strategy yield and the wrapper does not expose a separate borrower collateral market or token-level liquidation oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: Yuzu documents syzUSD as a technical staking wrapper: users convert yzUSD into syzUSD shares and can unstake back to yzUSD. The reviewed wrapper has no borrower-owned debt positions or separate collateral/liquidation branches; underlying yzUSD mechanics remain a parent-asset dependency.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Plasma is the only reviewed native syzUSD issuance route. Ethereum is a verified BridgeableTokenAdapterUpgradeable representation with a lockbox and owner-only locked-token withdrawal surface; Monad's current implementation is bridgeable/OFT code exposing CCIP mint/burn role surfaces, but its current pool, router, role grants, allowlists, limits, and message traces were not verified. Current LayerZero peers read as zero on both representations, so the historical OVault architecture is retained as evidence but no active LayerZero lane or CCIP conservation invariant is claimed. Bridge upgrade/admin controls remain explicitly scored here, with the route tier kept opaque-or-unknown until the live machinery is resolved.

routes.reviewNote: At Plasma block 29981334 on 2026-08-16, the transparent-proxy syzUSD ERC-4626 vault resolves to implementation 0xa3982582016375a0b25cb7d572379d3d49e5e9c8 and ProxyAdmin 0x7392751a860a51694231c7a0b4a9c853f8169cf0, whose owner is the 4-of-5 Safe 0xa2a9700407934e913c840556b3d29f19cf6f203d. asset() returns yzUSD 0x6695c0f8706c5ace3bdf8995073179cca47926dc, so current share issuance is native and deposit-bounded; the vault owner() EOA is operational-only. Native wrapper issuance is kept separate from bridge controls.

At Ethereum block 25770862 on 2026-08-16, this verified syzUSD representation resolves to BridgeableTokenAdapterUpgradeable implementation 0x692d91e94b55ec1360f20970010538263ce29b58, an OFT adapter with an underlying lockbox and owner-only locked-token withdrawal. The adapter is not a canonical native issuance deployment. LayerZero peers for the checked Plasma and Monad EIDs returned zero, and no current CCIP pool, router, role grant, allowlist, limit, or message trace was verified; the representation role is reviewed but an active lane and conservation invariant remain unresolved.
